name: flow-sales
description: Turns a sales methodology (MEDDPICC) from training people attend into a system of record, checks and daily stand-ups. Audits your CRM deals and meeting transcripts with quoted evidence, measures framework adoption per rep over time, links adoption to won and lost deals, and briefs each rep every morning. Local-first and read-only.

hubspot_token.title: HubSpot private app token (optional)
hubspot_token.description: Read scopes only: crm.objects.deals.read, crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.companies.read, crm.objects.owners.read, sales-email-read, crm.schemas.deals.read. Leave empty to use the HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable or .flow-sales/secrets.json. Read by fs.py as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_HUBSPOT_TOKEN.
